verdict.rationale: v0's own docs say it scaffolds full-stack apps, connects to databases and backends as it builds, and creates full-stack apps and agents. A community user built an app with auth, roles and export, which corroborates real backend logic. The docs never explicitly say a single prompt produces both frontend UI and backend logic together, and how deep the generated backend code goes is undocumented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of single-prompt frontend+backend generation, detail on generated backend logic (API routes, server actions, data models), independent hands-on confirmation that one prompt yields both layers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: Quickly scaffold full-stack apps or components following best practices and modern standards.
v0 is an AI agent that helps anyone create real code and full-stack apps and agents.
v0 plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds.
Connect to backend to build rich, data driven applications.
